routes.approach: Import WattsFoundation.SmallGeneratorBridge and Proofs.EilenbergWatts in the article workspace. Install Projective P and Projective Q from the respective reviewed premises. Apply equivalenceOfSmallProjectiveGenerator separately to P and Q with their actual separator and discrete-colimit-preservation hypotheses. The bridge already converts smallness and supplies both IsEquivalence fields. Use HP.asEquivalence and HQ.asEquivalence for the next step. Form the equivalence of functor categories by precomposing with the inverse of HP and postcomposing with HQ. Lift each direction to Good using additivity and preservation of the finite and Type v discrete colimits under composition. Lift the ambient unit and counit with ObjectProperty.isoMk. Apply the inverse of the registered EilenbergWatts equivalence to the opposite endomorphism rings in hom universe v, where the module carriers are also in v. The next independent elaboration check is a symbolic intertwining lemma. Identify the lifted regular R with HP.obj P using ULift.down, unop, and End.asHom. Show that right multiplication by op p corresponds to HP.map (End.asHom p), then transport that equality through the unit of HP.asEquivalence to evaluation at P. Define the forward bimodule functor directly on the carrier HQ.obj (F.obj P), with right action from F.obj.map (End.asHom p), and map θ by HQ.map (θ.app P). Use the intertwining lemma and the evaluation equality in EilenbergWatts to get a natural bimodule isomorphism from the transported equivalence to this direct functor. After changeFunctor, prove the strict functor equality to eval by the defined object and morphism maps. Verify the transported action formula (q ≫ b) ≫ F.obj.map (End.asHom p) and the morphism formula b ≫ θ.app P using that same equality witness. The retained plan still schedules ProjectiveGeneratorModuleReconstruction. The new classical bridge covers reconstruction for this article proof, and the separate portal item still requires audited choice-free inverse families. If the exact article proof is checked and audited with the bridge in the consumer import closure, submit that receipt for the engine's scoped decision on the held edge. A supplier-only audit does not establish the article correspondence.
